intro: {{count}} published MBA / PGDM colleges in Karnataka have a recorded average package higher than their recorded total fee. This page gathers the best MBA / PGDM colleges in Karnataka where average package exceeds fees, using only colleges where we hold both numbers.

Ten of the {{published}} colleges are in Bangalore, with two in Mangalore and one in Mysore. Alliance University is listed first, but its card shows a Global MBA at ₹2.25 lakh, which you should confirm against the official programme fee.
IBS Bengaluru appears with a recorded MBA Finance fee of ₹6.525 lakh and a 2022 average package of ₹9 lakh. That placement year is older than some others on the list, so read the year on each card.
listLead: These are the top MBA / PGDM colleges in Karnataka 2026 on this value filter. Several cards use a specialised title such as Global MBA or MBA Finance, so compare the same programme's official fee and placement report.
snapshot: For the {{feeN}} colleges with a recorded fee, the median total is {{feeMedian}}, and the middle half sits between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}.
{{private}} colleges are private. One college has no ownership type in our records. Recorded average packages range from {{pkgMin}} to {{pkgMax}}, from {{pkgYearMin}} to {{pkgYearMax}}.
CAT is the most common recorded entrance test here, with ATMA, MAT and PGCET also appearing. The highest recorded package is {{highestMax}}, which is not the average.
firstCollegesLead: Alliance University is ranked 71 in the official NIRF 2025 Management ranking. Confirm the official Global MBA or flagship MBA fee.
MS Ramaiah Institute of Technology has a recorded MBA fee of about ₹3.26 lakh, but we do not hold a placement average for it on this card. A missing package is not the same as a weak placement year.

sections.heading: Reading Karnataka MBA fees and packages
paragraphs: IBS Bengaluru's 2022 average of ₹9 lakh is the highest recorded average on this list, but it is four years behind the newest 2025 figures at AJ Institute of Management, Mangalore.
Besant Institute of Post Graduate Studies (MSNM), Mangalore, shows an MBA Finance fee of ₹50,000. Treat a figure that low as a prompt to check whether it is an annual tuition.

compare.heading: How to judge the best MBA / PGDM colleges in Karnataka where average package exceeds fees
paragraphs: Bangalore dominates this list, but a Mangalore or Mysore college with a clearer fee notice can still be a better personal fit.
Check these points before you apply:
bullets: The official fee for the exact programme on the card, especially where the title is Global MBA or a dual specialisation.
The placement year. Some averages here go back to 2015 or 2021.
Whether the college uses CAT, PGCET or ATMA for the latest cycle.
Whether ownership is clearly private or left blank in our records, and what that means for fee rules.

faqs.question: How many MBA colleges in Karnataka have an average package above fees?
faqs.answer: We list {{published}} published colleges in Karnataka on this filter. Colleges without a recorded fee or a recorded average package do not appear, even if they offer an MBA.

faqs.question: Why is Alliance University's MBA fee lower than IBS Bengaluru's on this list?
faqs.answer: The Alliance card shows a Global MBA at ₹2.25 lakh in our records, while IBS Bengaluru is listed with MBA Finance at ₹6.525 lakh. These may not be comparable flagship programmes, so confirm both official fee notices.

faqs.question: Which cities have the most colleges on this Karnataka list?
faqs.answer: Bangalore has ten of the {{published}} colleges, Mangalore has two, and Mysore has one. A city count is not a ranking of teaching quality.

faqs.question: Which exams do these Karnataka colleges accept?
faqs.answer: CAT is the most frequently recorded test, followed by ATMA, MAT and PGCET. Each college publishes its own cut-off and selection steps for the latest cycle.

faqs.question: Are the placement figures guaranteed?
faqs.answer: No. They are historical records from {{pkgYearMin}} to {{pkgYearMax}} in our data. Confirm the latest official placement report for the programme you want.
